tools.name: find_vessels_in_area
tools.description: Vessels currently inside a latitude/longitude bounding box, newest report first, with optional kind and ship-type filters. Anonymous calls may cover 100 square degrees per call.

tools.name: find_vessels_near
tools.description: Vessels within a radius (default 10 NM, maximum 50) of a point or of another vessel's last known position, nearest first, each with distance and bearing from the centre.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Where Open Waters AIS is hearing AIS right now: sources with their current delay, stations, freshness, and vessel counts. A bounding box adds the stations whose coverage overlaps that area and a count of vessels in it. A station ID adds statistics for that station. Vessel counts cover the last 30 mi

tools.name: get_vessel_track
tools.description: The positions heard from one vessel over a time range, oldest first, with speed, course, and navigational status. Positions implying an impossible speed for the vessel are left out. A vessel can be identified by MMSI, or by IMO with a feeder or partner token. A call covers up to a year. By default t

tools.name: get_vessels
tools.description: Last known position and particulars of specific vessels by MMSI (Maritime Mobile Service Identity), or by IMO number with a feeder or partner token: the last report heard for each, however long ago, with destination, ETA, draught, and dimensions once its static data has been heard, and which identif

tools.name: search_vessels_by_name
tools.description: Vessels whose name contains the text, case-insensitive, among every vessel the network has heard, each with its MMSI and last known position when available. An optional bounding box narrows the search. With a feeder or partner token, text of the form IMO 9241061 finds the vessels reporting that IMO
